skill_name: Describe the benefits of using GPT for natural language processing tasks.
workflow: GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) is a transformer-based language model. It has gained attention for its promise in helping automate different Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks such as relevant questions answering, document summarization, and text generation.
